act_info.act_name: 50% Auto Rebate Level Up Challenge Part 1 - July 2025

buttons.name: Win Free Dinos - Join Family Now

textContent.value: Join us for our 50% Auto- Rebate Part 1 in July, meet other hosts, and get yourself rewarded.⚡
⏰ Event run time: 6:00 PM - 9:00 PM PST

🟣 Rewards Structure 

lv.1 - if 5,000 beans received, get 2,500 beans reward

lv.2 - if 10,000 beans received, get extra 2,500 beans reward

lv.3 - if 20,000 beans received, get extra 5,000 beans reward

lv.4 - if 40,000 beans received, get extra 10,000 beans reward

lv.5 - if 60,000 beans received, get extra 10,000 beans reward

lv.6 - if 80,000 beans received, get extra 10,000 beans reward

lv.7 - if 100,000 beans received, get extra 10,000 beans reward

lv.8 - if 120,000 beans received, get extra 10,000 beans reward

lv.9 - if 140,000 beans received, get extra 10,000 beans reward

lv.10 - if 160,000 beans received, get extra 10,000 beans reward

The maximum reward you can receive is 80,000 beans reward
💃 Go live in Solo or Multiguest Room as a host at least 20 mins within the hour, you can do all event formats you like!
